prompt: Compose an original complete 30-second instrumental cue for spacious playful object transformations. Instruments: organ stabs, deep bass, rimshot, short tape echo. 94 BPM in 4/4. Motif: a clipped falling fifth answered by two repeated notes. Start the hook and beat immediately; maintain a clear pulse and concise two-bar phrases. One fresh timbral answer halfway through. Keep the groove throughout, then a decisive tonic ending during the last second with a very short natural decay. No slow intro, long outro, riser, silence or fade-out. Mobile-speaker-friendly bass. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. No imitation of any artist, song, film, game or brand.

description.en: An upbeat and playful electronic track with a driving beat, featuring a prominent arpeggiated synth melody and a retro video game aesthetic. The music is energetic and has a clear, consistent rhythm.
